: >"$result"
for i in $(seq 1 16); do
  (
    exec 3<>/dev/tcp/10.100.56.10/9097 || exit 1
    sleep 2
    printf 'PING\n' >&3
    IFS= read -r response <&3
    printf '%02d %s\n' "$i" "$response" >>"$result"
    exec 3<&-
    exec 3>&-
  ) &
done
wait
printf 'FINAL_CONCURRENT_COUNT='; wc -l <"$result"
printf 'FINAL_CONCURRENT_NON_PONG='; grep -vc ' PONG$' "$result" || true
sort -n "$result"
